name: repo-indexer
purpose: Summarize repo structure, routes, components, services, API clients, models, and tests into a compact architecture map.
use_when: Understanding project layout before making changes
avoid_when: The needed file or symbol is already known
The task only requires reading one small file

inputs.scope: Optional path, symbol, route, or topic to focus indexing.
inputs.include_tests: Optional boolean for whether test files should be included.

outputs.files: Compact list of relevant files and roles.
outputs.symbols: Relevant functions, classes, routes, or service entry points.
outputs.tests: Related test files or commands when known.
outputs.commands: Commands used to produce the summary.

notes: Planned tool. Until implemented, use rg and targeted file reads to approximate this behavior.
